items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new News-category item. Direct fetch of elcogen.com/news confirms the Sept 21, 2026 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement remains the latest "News" post (30 days old); a new "Insights" piece ("What could electrification mean for the chemical industry?", Oct 6, 2026) is a thought-leadership article, not company/product news. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release. topsoe.com/press-releases is topped by the Oct 14 Bharat Petroleum SAF ("Kerosene Hydrotreating Technology") contract — Topsoe's hydroprocessing business, out of SOFC/SOEC scope. The last SOFC/SOEC-relevant release remains the Aug 27 H1 2026 results / March 2026 SOEC pathway reset (55 days). A March 2026 Topsoe CEO transition (Elena Scaltritti replacing Roeland Baan, effective March 5) surfaced in today's search but is confirmed old news with no stated SOEC/SOFC strategy implications — not adopted.
Today's dedicated rotation — cycle 3, round 3 (Kyocera, Aisin, Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol, Plansee, Watt Fuel Cell, OxEon Energy), 7-day lookback: No new items for any of the six.
Kyocera: Results were enkiai.com SEO-aggregator "2025 strategy" pieces and a 2017-vintage "Industry's First 3kW SOFC for institutional cogeneration" press item — no 2026-dated company news.
Aisin: Same enkiai.com aggregator pieces and generic SOFC market-research reports; no company-specific disclosure found.

Fraunhofer IKTS / Kerafol: Results were the already-logged thyssenkrupp nucera/IKTS SOEC commercialization item and a Korean-shipbuilding/Fraunhofer MoU (maritime, not data-center) — both previously dated, no new item.
Plansee: Only background/market-report hits (an old $1.26B "Planar SOFC Market Outlook to 2026" report, legacy patents) — no new company news.

Watt Fuel Cell: Latest substantive items remain the July 23, 2026 equity-financing close and the Dec 2025 first WATT HOME 2kW residential install/Hope Gas shipments ahead of a 2026 residential launch — no new item since; Watt is residential/light-commercial PEM-adjacent SOFC micro-CHP, not AI-datacenter scale, and stays a background watch item rather than a benchmark entry.

OxEon Energy: An Oct 5, 2026 Utah Business feature on OxEon's Mars-heritage SOEC technology and a DOE-funded SOEC manufacturing-automation project surfaced, but it is outside the 7-day benchmark lookback (16 days old) and is a technology/funding-program profile rather than a new KPI disclosure — not adopted, flagged for completeness only.

Sweep — "Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR SolydEra": No new items; results were the already-logged SolydEra Hannover Messe 2026 PMX-platform coverage and recirculated coverage of the Sept 18 Doosan-Reverion $78M SOFC-stack supply contract.

Broad cross-company sweep (AI-datacenter and funding-round queries covering Bloom, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, PowerCell, Reverion and others): No new SOFC-specific KPI surfaced; see AI Data Center Deployments and Market & Financials below for the (non-new) items that did resurface.

Other key players (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Weichai): not in today's dedicated rotation; no items surfaced incidentally beyond what is already logged.
